title: What Pro-finder is intended for
body_md: Pro-finder is a tracking system for leisure vehicles. It determines the vehicle position using GPS and mobile network technology and reports it exclusively by text message; the format depends on the mobile device. The device is **not** intended for recording routes and **not** for live tracking. Combined with other components it also reports alarms from a connected alarm system and gas alarms from connected gas warning devices. Pro-finder may only be used in accordance with the instructions in this manual.
